description.zh: 命令ID。您可以通过接口[DescribeCommands](~~64843~~)查询所有可用的CommandId。
description.en: The command ID. You can call the [DescribeCommands](~~64843~~) operation to query all available command IDs.

description.zh: 命令描述，支持全字符集。长度不得超过512个字符。
description.en: The description of the command. The description supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length.

description.zh: 命令名称，支持全字符集。长度不得超过128个字符。
description.en: The name of the command. The name supports all character sets and can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查询可用地域。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [ListRegions](~~189315~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 您创建的命令在ECS实例中执行时最大的超时时间，单位为秒。当因为某种原因无法运行您创建的命令时，会出现超时现象。超时后，会强制终止命令进程，即取消命令的PID。默认值：60。
description.en: The maximum timeout period for the command execution on the ECS instance. Unit: seconds. When a command that you created cannot be run, the command execution times out. When the execution times out, the command process is forcefully terminated and the PID of the command is canceled. Default value: 60.

description.zh: 执行路径。长度不得超过200个字符。
description.en: The working directory of the command. The directory can be up to 200 characters in length.
